params.caption: 🎮 Epic Games says it owns Jazz Jackrabbit, blocking Cliff Bleszinski Gears of War and Unreal Tournament designer Cliff Bleszinski tried to get back the rights to Jazz Jackrabbit, one of the very first characters he created. His former employer Epic Games pushed back and claimed ownership of the character, in a legal dispute tied to Fortnite. 🕒 Nov 9, 2026 · 23:55 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN #EpicGames #Fortnite #GamingNews
